title: Two Machine-Checked Conditional Routes to the Riemann Hypothesis
description: Lean-checked formalization scaffold and research manuscript for two conditional routes to the Riemann Hypothesis. The release records the generic Grassmann/Fekete Toeplitz closure, exact-ready effective and Jensen receptors, numerical diagnostics, theorem-status ledger, and remaining open analytic inputs. It does not claim a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
